mode.title: Protection level for every site
mode.description: basic: network blocking only; standard: the page itself (default); strict: also inside embedded frames.

siteModes.title: Protection level of particular sites
siteModes.description: Host name → basic | standard | strict. Users cannot change these sites.

allowlist.title: Always allowed sites
allowlist.description: Host names where nothing is blocked. Added to the user's own; users cannot remove them.

features.title: Features
features.description: true or false for each listed feature; features not listed stay the user's choice.

lists.title: Filter lists
lists.description: List id (see the extension's Settings → Filter lists) → true or false.

autoUpdate.title: Filter updates
autoUpdate.description: Download the signed filter data (filters.json) about twice a day.

reviewAsk.title: Chrome Web Store review prompt
reviewAsk.description: false: never ask users for a review.

sync.title: Sync settings across devices
sync.description: Copy settings to the user's browser account (storage.sync).

disablePause.title: No pause or switch-off
disablePause.description: true: users cannot pause protection or turn it off.

disableUserExceptions.title: No user exceptions
disableUserExceptions.description: true: users cannot allow sites or change the protection level of a site.
